title: CodeChef: Is your horseshoe on the other hoof?
description: Valera has 4 horseshoes with colors given in list `s`. To look stylish, he needs all 4 to have distinct colors. Find the minimum number of horseshoes he must buy.
solution:
def horseshoes_to_buy(s: list[int]) -> int:
    return 4 - len(set(s))
explanation: Difference between total horseshoes and unique colors gives required purchases in O(1) time.
